text:
Mia (oncall): 👋 heads up, north2c reporting increased GPU attach failures and intermittent egress 5xx to external registries. Non-critical tenants getting >30% task failures. Starting soft drains for best-effort pools now.
Arjun: on it. can you share the attach/error counts? any spike in preemptions?
Mia (oncall): attach fail rate from GPUs jumped at 10:22 UTC. Preemptions normal, but control-plane to node IO shows timeouts. 50 pods failed attach over the last 10m. CPU on orchestrator healthy.
SRE-Bot: [ALERT] region:north2c - gpu_attach_failures > 25m avg (50m window). Ticket #INF-4521 created.
Leo: sounds like network egress or NIC issue in that AZ. Suggest we avoid cold-starting new GPU nodes there and keep warm replicas in north2b.
Sam: starting cordon+drain for non-prod GPU nodepool gpupool-n2c-soft-1. Will use graceful drain and keep KV cache warm in north2b.
Sam: command I'm running:```kubectl cordon node/gpu-node-14-n2c && kubectl drain node/gpu-node-14-n2c --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120```
Arjun: good. after drain, we should update smart-routing policy to shift canary traffic to north2b then north2a. Do gradual weights: 10% -> 30% -> 60% over 5m windows.
Priya: flag on cost: if we rehydrate warm nodes in north2b using reserved capacity it's fine, but if we spin up on-demand gpus for 1-2 hours, cost hits will show up in daily SOD alerts. Propose using spot fallback only for non-critical, keep customer-facing stable on reserved.
Mia (oncall): agreed. Plan: 1) drain non-prod gpupool-n2c-soft, 2) shift traffic by route weights to north2b (pref reserved), 3) failover for critical model-service to north2a if errors persist >30m.
Leo: also lowering max_batch_size to reduce attach churn for short-lived jobs helps. I'll push a runtime flag: `MAX_BATCH=8` for the canary service in shifted routes.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: runtime-config update for model-service (canary): MAX_BATCH -> 8 (deploy id: d-8891).
Arjun: I'll monitor latencies. If p95 spikes >200ms during weight shift, pause and rollback to previous weights.
Mia (oncall): timeline: start drains 10:35 UTC, begin weight shift 10:40 UTC. I'll update status every 5m.
Priya: I'll pre-approve a 2hr on-demand fallback budget if we need fast capacity. Keep me in loop.
Sam: drains started. 6 nodes cordoned, 4 draining, expected finish ~10:48 UTC.
SRE-Bot: [UPDATE] gpupool-n2c-soft-1 drain progress: 4/10 pods rescheduled. No redeploys required.
Arjun: weight shift started: north2b +15%, north2c -15%. Monitoring routing errors and queue length.
Leo: noticed slight cache miss bump; warming prefix cache in north2b now.
Mia (oncall): after first window, attach failures dropped to 12. continuing to 30% weight to north2b.
Sam: drains complete for targeted non-prod nodes. Leaving a small warm pool (2 nodes) in north2c for stateful workloads that can't move.
Priya: cost note logged to #finance-alerts — potential +$1.2k if we hold on-demand for 2 hours. OK to proceed if SLA impact > 10%.
Arjun: second window complete. p95 latency +20ms, error rate stable. continuing gradual.
Mia (oncall): critical services still showing occasional attach errors (~3/min). if this persists past 30m we'll trigger cross-AZ evacuation for those pods.
Leo: I'll keep cache warm and reduce batch further if we see more churn.
Mia (oncall): thanks team. will post final summary once stabilized or if we escalate. :thumbsup:
